study type: Pooled data analysis of pregnancy registries
outcome: Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Disease Activity Index (BASDAI)
cohort: 332 pregnancies from 304 women with axSpA fulfilling ASAS classification criteria
finding: Pregnancy outcomes in women with axSpA were favorable, with rates of adverse outcomes comparable to or better than those reported for the general population.
mod_finding: Neonates were delivered by caesarean section in 27.7% of pregnancies, of which 47.4% were emergencies.
